questions.question: How should I keep the battery over the winter when I'm not riding?
questions.answer: For winter storage, keep the battery at 50–70% charge in a dry place between 10 and 20 °C, and top it back up to that level every three months. [2] Never store it fully empty, because a cell that drops below its minimum voltage may never charge again and that damage is not covered by warranty. [2] If the bike is stored outside for more than a day, remove the battery and take it indoors. [3]
